title: SimpleBlobStoreActionCache#downloadBlob should timeout when backend doesn't answer

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
We had a hanging `bazel build` job on CI this morning:
https://buildkite.com/bazel/bazel-with-downstream-projects-bazel/builds/180#94b43a46-ccf2-44f9-8b8f-2a7703a60111

I saved the stack trace from the machine:
```
# Connect to the worker.
gcloud compute ssh root@buildkite-ubuntu1604-dncf
# Get the PID of the bazel client (not server!).
ps axuf
# Run jstack on it.
jstack 27831
# This will trigger the server to dump a stack trace into its jvm.out.
# The path to the log is printed in Buildkite:
# Sending SIGQUIT to JVM process 27831 (see /var/lib/buildkite-agent/.cache/bazel/_bazel_buildkite-agent/dccf24614aa202a669b9d141b873f6b4/server/jvm.out).
exit
gcloud compute scp root@buildkite-ubuntu-1604-dncf:/var/lib/buildkite-agent/.cache/bazel/_bazel_buildkite-agent/dccf24614aa202a669b9d141b873f6b4/server/jvm.out ~/jvm.out
```
